subject: Ledgers repair: request for service concession and invoice reconciliation
messages:
From: Olivia Price <olivia.price@nimblehealth.io>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, finance@nimblehealth.io
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@nimblehealth.io>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Unexpected duplicated charge line on Oct invoices

Hi Logan,

Hope you’re well. We were reconciling October close and flagged what looks like a duplicated metered charge that posted across two invoice line items (INV-20261017 and INV-20261101). Our AP team shows an overpayment of $12,450 on Redwood services as a result.

Can you please:
- Confirm whether Redwood sees duplicate processing for our account between 10/15–11/02.
- Share ledger lines (CSV) used to generate those invoices so we can match to our GL.
- Propose next steps for a corrective invoice or credit note — we need the tax-compliant paperwork for our accounting close.

We’re happy to provide any supporting docs from our side; attaching a short screenshot of the two invoice lines. We’d like to resolve before our month-end close.

Thanks,
Olivia Price
Finance Operations
NimbleHealth

Attachment: invoice-lines-snip.png (image)
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Price <olivia.price@nimblehealth.io>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected duplicated charge line on Oct invoices

Hi Olivia — thanks for the flag and the screenshot.

I’ve looped in Rachel (billing) and Monica (accounts) to run a quick reconciliation. Ben is cc’d to keep account leadership in the loop.

Two quick asks so we can move fast:
1) Could you attach the full invoice PDFs (INV-20261017 and INV-20261101) and any relevant PO/receipt numbers your AP team uses?
2) If you can share the GL export or confirm which ledger keys to map against, we’ll use that to produce a matching CSV and a proposed remediation (credit note + goodwill concession if applicable).

We’ll prioritize this and aim to send a preliminary reconciliation within 24–48 hours. If there’s urgency around a tax period close on your side, call out the deadline and we’ll escalate.

Best,
Logan Wright
Director, Account Success
Redwood Inference
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Price <olivia.price@nimblehealth.io>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T15:28:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected duplicated charge line on Oct invoices — preliminary reconciliation attached

Hi Olivia / team — attaching a short spreadsheet with our reconciliation traces: prelim-recon-20261121.xlsx.

Summary (high level):
- Root cause: duplicate ledger ingestion for a subset of metered events (batch re-ingest on 2026-10-31).
- Total overbill identified: $12,450.00 (USD). We traced duplicated event IDs and line-item timestamps.

Proposed remediation:
1) Issue a corrective credit note for $12,450.00 to offset the next invoice (we can also issue a refund if you prefer ACH — please advise).
2) As a gesture of goodwill for operational disruption, apply a one-month burst credit equivalent to $3,000 on your December 2026 billing cycle.
3) VAT/tax handling: We will generate a tax-compliant credit note — to do this we need NimbleHealth’s VAT/Tax ID and the invoice/PO numbers as requested by Logan. If Nimble is outside the US and requires a VAT-stamped credit note, we will route this through our tax team; processing may take an additional 3–5 business days.

Next steps from us: Monica will prepare the formal credit note (PDF) and update your account ledger. Rachel (billing) will send the credit note and an adjusted invoice for your records.

Please confirm: (A) whether you want the credit applied to the next invoice or refunded, and (B) the VAT/Tax ID for issuance.

Regards,
Rachel Kim
Billing Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: prelim-recon-20261121.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Olivia Price <olivia.price@nimblehealth.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reed <tom.reed@nimblehealth.io>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-23T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected duplicated charge line on Oct invoices — preliminary reconciliation attached

Hi Rachel / Logan — thanks for the rapid turnaround and for digging in.

We accept the proposed remediation: please apply the $12,450 as a credit against our next invoice and include the $3,000 goodwill burst credit. We prefer the credit applied rather than an ACH refund.

VAT/Tax details attached (Nimble_VAT_98765.pdf). Our accounting contact (finance@nimblehealth.io) is looped for the paperwork.

Two requests to close out on our end:
- Please send the formal credit note and adjusted invoice (PDF) with a clear description we can attach to our AP records.
- If there’s a DocuSign or mutual action plan (MAP) to acknowledge the credit and the goodwill concession, send the link and we’ll get sign-off from Tom Reed by end of day tomorrow.

Thanks again — appreciate the fast handling.

Best,
Olivia Price
Finance Operations
NimbleHealth

Attachment: Nimble_VAT_98765.pdf (tax id)
